title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Confident and Invisible
caption:
What it actually looks like for a godly man to be confident and invisible. Sturdy enough to lead. Small enough to kneel.

He can walk into a room and not need it to notice him. He hands the credit somewhere else. He can be wrong and stay standing.

Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up (James 4:10).

Real confidence and real humility come from the same place. He already knows who he is, so he's got nothing left to prove.
